about: Maths as the model writes it, delimited or not, mangled or not, and code that must stay as it is, with the text each must become. 'tagged' is what repair_reply makes of 'input', with graspy's <latex-inline> and <latex-block> tags; the web's processLatex must make the same text with $ and $$ for the tags. 'lesson' is what repair_markdown makes of it when that differs (a lesson's JSON fields also restore doubled backslashes and keep a list of letters as text). Read by apps/server/tests/test_math_repair_corpus.py, apps/web/src/lib/latex.test.ts and apps/server/ui/src/shared/latex.test.ts, so the three cannot drift.
